description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule, which models an XHTML 1.1 module with properties for elements, attributes, content sets, and transformations used in HTML purification. It includes methods for adding elements, creating blank elements, registering content sets, parsing content models, and merging attribute includes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule
classes.description: A class representing an XHTML 1.1 module with properties and methods for managing HTML elements, attributes, content sets, and transformations within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: getChildDef
methods.description: Returns false; intended to retrieve a child definition subclass based on element definitions.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Sets up a new HTML element with specified content model, attributes, and content set registration.

methods.name: addBlankElement
methods.description: Creates a new, non-standalone, blank element definition.

methods.name: addElementToContentSet
methods.description: Registers an element to a specified content set.

methods.name: parseContents
methods.description: Transforms a string describing allowed children into content model type and content model.

methods.name: mergeInAttrIncludes
methods.description: Merges attribute includes into an attribute array.

methods.name: makeLookup
methods.description: Creates a lookup table from a list of values with boolean true as values.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Placeholder for lazy loading setup, takes a configuration object.
